knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(stringr)
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
})

obj <- readRDS(file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj.rds"))
fig_dir <- "figures"
out_dir <- "results"

cluster_order <- levels(Idents(obj))
cluster_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(cluster_order)), cluster_order)
```

```{r}
femur <- subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Femoral")

composition <- tibble(
  Cluster = factor(as.character(Idents(femur)), levels = cluster_order),
  condition = factor(femur$condition, levels = c("VEH", "THC"))
) %>%
  count(Cluster, condition, name = "n") %>%
  complete(Cluster, condition, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_composition <- ggplot(
  composition,
  aes(x = Cluster, y = percent, fill = Cluster, alpha = condition)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, guide = "none", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(VEH = 0.35, THC = 1), name = "Condition") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 18)) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "% of cluster") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1, face = "bold"))

p_composition
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure2A_femoral_composition.png"), p_composition,
       width = 16, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(femur) <- "RNA"
Idents(femur) <- factor(femur$condition, levels = c("VEH", "THC"))

# This value is retained from the original femoral analysis script.
min_pct_global <- 0.1

deg_femoral <- FindMarkers(
  femur,
  ident.1 = "THC",
  ident.2 = "VEH",
  assay = "RNA",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = min_pct_global,
  only.pos = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC)))

write_csv(deg_femoral, file.path(out_dir, "Femoral_THC_vs_VEH_DEG.csv"))
```

```{r}
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 0.25

volcano_df <- deg_femoral %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10padj = -log10(pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    group = case_when(
      p_val_adj < padj_cut & avg_log2FC >= lfc_cut ~ "Up in THC",
      p_val_adj < padj_cut & avg_log2FC <= -lfc_cut ~ "Down in THC",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_up <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(group == "Up in THC") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  pull(gene)

top_down <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(group == "Down in THC") %>%
  arrange(avg_log2FC) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(gene)

volcano_df$label <- ifelse(
  volcano_df$gene %in% c(top_up, top_down),
  volcano_df$gene,
  NA_character_
)

p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(avg_log2FC, neglog10padj)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Down in THC" = "#0072B2",
    "Not significant" = "grey80",
    "Up in THC" = "#D55E00"
  )) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volcano_df, !is.na(label)),
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change~(THC/VEH)),
       y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(p))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

p_volcano
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure2B_femoral_volcano.png"), p_volcano,
       width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", collection = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
hallmark_sets <- split(hallmark$gene_symbol, hallmark$gs_name)

ranks <- setNames(deg_femoral$avg_log2FC, deg_femoral$gene)
set.seed(123)
gsea_femoral <- fgsea(
  pathways = hallmark_sets,
  stats = ranks,
  minSize = 10,
  maxSize = 1000,
  nperm = 10000
) %>%
  arrange(padj)

write_csv(gsea_femoral, file.path(out_dir, "Femoral_THC_vs_VEH_Hallmark_GSEA.csv"))

plot_df <- gsea_femoral %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    Pathway = str_remove(pathway, "^HALLMARK_") %>% str_replace_all("_", " "),
    mlogFDR = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    Pathway = factor(Pathway, levels = Pathway[order(NES)])
  )

p_gsea <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NES, Pathway)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES, yend = Pathway), color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(size = mlogFDR, color = NES)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2676B8", mid = "grey90", high = "#CB3E38", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_gsea
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure2C_femoral_Hallmark_GSEA.png"), p_gsea,
       width = 7.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
